traits.wood_density_basic_kg_m3.note: GWDD v.2.2 genus aggregate for Avicennia (gwddagg_v2.2_genus.csv, read): specific gravity 0.64 (wsg_est, the hierarchical-model genus mean, from 386 records in 22 sources); trunks 0.64, branches 0.59. A species with its own measurements states its own. Basic density is the specific gravity times 1000 kg/m3.

traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz's description of the black mangroves (Avicenniaceae) (the DELTA distribution's own page for it, read 2026-10-15): flowers regular; calyx 5, slightly bilabiate; corolla 4, gamopetalous, its lobes about as long as the tube or longer, rotate or campanulate, regular, yellow; stamens 4, in the throat of the corolla tube, slightly didynamous or not. The Flora of the Cayman Islands (Plants of the World Online) gives a corolla of a short tube and 4 almost equal spreading lobes; PROTA calls it slightly zygomorphic (as quoted in search results; those pages themselves were not read). Drawn regular, 4-merous.
